abstract: Maintains non-destructive sensor calibration and measurement uncertainty models
system_message:
You are the Forensic instrumentation specialist (INST), responsible for maintaining non-destructive sensor calibration and measurement uncertainty models, as well as ambient vibration monitoring records across candidate investigation protocols.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Ambient vibration monitoring（VIBE）
information_points.content:
INST-VIBE-40X：Under the In-Situ Radiographic Tomography and Chemical Speciation Protocol, ambient vibration telemetry on the damaged furnace superstructure foundation recorded a structural resonance frequency of 42 Hz.
INST-VIBE-JDJ：Under the Transient Dynamic Simulation and Fracture Mechanics Protocol, ambient vibration telemetry on the damaged furnace superstructure foundation recorded a structural resonance frequency of 28 Hz.
INST-VIBE-SFH：Under the Acoustic Emission and Metallurgical Sectioning Protocol, ambient vibration telemetry on the damaged furnace superstructure foundation recorded a structural resonance frequency of 14 Hz.

information_points.title: Maintains non-destructive sensor calibration and measurement uncertainty models（SENS）
information_points.content:
INST-SENS-TQX：For the Transient Dynamic Simulation and Fracture Mechanics Protocol, the non-destructive measurement uncertainty score derived from sensor resolution and noise margins across in-situ volumetric scanning and crack propagation sensors is 15 points.
INST-SENS-NV4：For the In-Situ Radiographic Tomography and Chemical Speciation Protocol, the non-destructive measurement uncertainty score derived from sensor resolution and noise margins across in-situ volumetric scanning and crack propagation sensors is 25 points.
INST-SENS-79D：For the Acoustic Emission and Metallurgical Sectioning Protocol, the non-destructive measurement uncertainty score derived from sensor resolution and noise margins across in-situ volumetric scanning and crack propagation sensors is 25 points.
